newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sasol in 193 mln rand Secunda gas extension.
newsitem.headline: Sasol in 193 mln rand Secunda gas extension.

text.p: Synthetic fuel producer Sasol Ltd said on Monday it would spend 193 million rand to de-bottleneck the company's gas production plant and refinery in Secunda.

"The planned extension in gas production capacity at the plant will result in an increase of about five percent in the production of pure gas which will be fully utilised to produce additional white products," Sasol said in a statement.
Sasol said the project was aimed at producing additional gas through the plant's reactors.
"Implementation of the project will also make provision for the modifications of gas cooling, gas and water separation, sulphur recovery and the tar refinery," the company said.

The implementation of the refinery's advanced control system was scheduled to be completed by August 1998 while the rest of the modifications will take place during plant shutdowns in September 1997 and March 1998.
